title: Skyblocker Modpack - Hypixel Skyblock
description: A Hypixel Skyblock Modpack with common client-side utilities, along with the Skyblocker mod.
author: Wohlhabend

license.name: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 only

body:
This modpack includes useful client-side **utility** and **performance** mods alongside the [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap) mod. \ \ This modpack is intended for the Skyblock game mode on hypixel.net. ![skyblocker modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8a4c330bbdca709daf28afdf491b272afca6e74.png) ## 🔧 Mods
Installed mods (29 mods) ### Hypixel Quality Of Life Mods: - [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap) - [Aaron’s Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/aaron-mod) ### Performance Mods: - [Async Logger](https://modrinth.com/mod/asynclogger) - [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - [Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - [Particle Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-core) - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) ### Quality Of Life Mods: - [Tooltip Scroll](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltip-scroll) - [Chat Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatpatches) - [Gamma Utils (Full-bright)](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) - [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) - [Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) - [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) ### Miscellaneous: - [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - [YOSBR](https://modrinth.com/mod/yosbr) - [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) - [ResourcePackCached](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourcepackcached) ### Libraries: - [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) - [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config) - [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) - [Text Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) - [Simple Modpack Update Checker](https://modrinth.com/mod/smuc)
## 🎨 Recommended Resource Packs
Resource Packs - [Hypixel Plus](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hypixel-plus) - Requires [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)! - [FurSky Reborn](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/furfsky-reborn) - Requires [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)! - [Skyblock Dark UI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/skyblock-dark-ui)
